coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Experiential Marketing Associate role has to turn events into brand awareness and customer relationships across both Consumer and Institutional audiences, and that only works when someone owns every detail from concept to wrap-up. I'm early in my career, but I've already seen what a well-planned event does. I helped plan a weekend adoption event at Harbor Street Pet Supply that brought in about 300 visitors.

That internship was my first taste of live events, and it sits alongside two years running the Instagram and TikTok accounts of the Westbrook Film Society. There I raised average screening ticket sales from 35 to 60 per event, and I trained two new volunteers. I haven't yet managed vendors, contracts or budgets at the scale you describe, and I haven't used platforms like Splash or Cvent. What I do bring is copywriting, Canva and Instagram Insights for measuring what engages people, and the Google Analytics for Beginners certificate, which gives me a base for the post-event reporting you want tied to attendance and engagement. Serving up to 150 customers per shift at Corner Bean Cafe taught me to stay organized and friendly when things get busy.

I'd like to bring that energy to a team that sets a high bar and wants people who learn fast. I'm available to start whenever suits you and would welcome a conversation about where I can contribute to Coinbase's events calendar.

Best regards,
Maya Linden
